findings.name: Dashboard chat proxy contract
findings.assertion: POST /brain-dashboard/chat returns ok=true with all dashboard-required fields

findings.name: Dashboard chat error shape
findings.assertion: When upstream 8091 is unreachable, /brain-dashboard/chat returns {ok:false, error, content}

findings.name: Dashboard trace proxy contract
findings.assertion: GET /brain-dashboard/agent-v2/runs/{run_id}/trace proxies to /v2/agent/runs/{run_id}/trace and returns {ok, run_id, trace, event_count}

findings.name: Dashboard agent-v2/status contract
findings.assertion: GET /brain-dashboard/agent-v2/status returns ok=true with agent_v2 block containing backend and chat_agent_route=/v2/chat/agent

findings.name: Main dashboard status includes agent_v2 panel
findings.assertion: GET /brain-dashboard/status contains agent_v2 block with backend, runs, trace_available

findings.name: Build mode escalation contract
findings.assertion: Dashboard chat build mode maps mode_escalation_required=true, required_permission='build', confirmation_id, expected_write_scope

findings.name: Auto mode exposes auto_decision
findings.assertion: Dashboard chat auto mode maps auto_decision field

findings.name: Scope guard
findings.assertion: No dashboard or source files modified
